title: BPW-2026-0532
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0532
CD 11
REVISED CONSTRUCTION BUDGET AND CONSTRUCTION ORDERS – MIKE PRLICH & SONS, INC.
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE a revised construction budget of $4,500,000, including contingency, for the West of Palisades Drive - Debris Basin No. 69 Emergency Storm Drain Repair Project; and
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue revised construction orders to Mike Prlich & Sons, Inc., up to the authorized revised construction budget for the project.
(W.O.: SZS12102​​​​​​, C-141941)
